sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 382)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio and British BBC broadcasting, the premiere episode of J.R.R. Tolkien's *The Hobbit* on BBC Radio 4 starring Paul Daneman & Heron Carvic (1968), Everett Sloane as psychological sleuth *Crime Doctor* for Philip Morris (1943), Al Jolson hosting Dolores Costello Barrymore & Martha Raye for Colgate (1936), Morton Wishengrad's *The Woman Rich in Time* on *The Eternal Light* (1948), BBC courtroom drama on *Saturday Night Theatre* (1953), and NBC's *Faith and Thought* (1936–1971):
